coordinate_system: UE metres: X north, Y east, Z up, origin = map centre; playable square +-2016 m

sample_notes.s: arc length from the road start (m)
sample_notes.heading_deg: compass bearing of travel: 0 = +X (north), 90 = +Y (east), clockwise seen from above
sample_notes.bank_deg: superelevation; positive = right edge lower than the left edge (rolls into right-hand curves)
sample_notes.width: paved width = lanes + median (m); shoulders are separate (road.shoulder_width)
sample_notes.z: finished road surface height on the centre line (m); the carved terrain bed is z - 0.05 m
